Summary: Provision is God's care for the material needs of His creatures, from manna in the wilderness to daily bread in the Lord's Prayer. Scripture ties it to both trust and work: God provides, and His people labor, share, and steward what they receive. Provision is never promised as luxury, and it is never merely spiritual - the God who feeds ravens and clothes lilies notices what His children need and meets it, often through other people's hands.
RelatedEvents: Wilderness Wanderings; The Feeding of the Five Thousand
